title: Postgres
description: Managed Postgres, FerretDB and Babelfish services, from the CloudNativePG metrics the resource group's Alloy collects.

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_collector_up' AND Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] != ''

panels.title: Status

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  up.service AS Service,
  up.v AS Up,
  up.pods AS Instances,
  version.v AS Version,
  conn.v AS Connections,
  maxconn.v AS `Max connections`,
  size.v AS `Database size`,
  lag.v AS `Replication lag`,
  errors.v AS `Exporter errors`
FROM (SELECT service, max(v) AS v, count() AS pods FROM (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND MetricName = 'cnpg_collector_up'
  GROUP BY service, series) GROUP BY service) AS up
LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, argMax(Attributes['full'], TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND MetricName = 'cnpg_collector_postgres_version'
  GROUP BY service) AS version USING service
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, sum(v) AS v FROM (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND MetricName = 'cnpg_backends_total'
  GROUP BY service, series) GROUP BY service) AS conn USING service
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, max(v) AS v FROM (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_settings_setting' AND Attributes['name'] = 'max_connections'
  GROUP BY service, series) GROUP BY service) AS maxconn USING service
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, sum(v) AS v FROM (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_database_size_bytes' AND Attributes['datname'] NOT IN ('template0', 'template1')
  GROUP BY service, series) GROUP BY service) AS size USING service
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, max(v) AS v FROM (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_replication_lag'
  GROUP BY service, series) GROUP BY service) AS lag USING service
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, max(v) AS v FROM (SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND MetricName = 'cnpg_collector_last_collection_error'
  GROUP BY service, series) GROUP BY service) AS errors USING service
WHERE up.service IN (${service:singlequote})
ORDER BY Service
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1

panels.description: Latest values from the last 10 minutes. Up is 0 when the CloudNativePG exporter can't reach Postgres; Exporter errors is 1 when some of its queries fail, and the other columns may then be empty.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, service, sum(v) AS value FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, avg(Value) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_backends_total' AND service IN (${service:singlequote})
  GROUP BY time, service, series
) GROUP BY time, service ORDER BY time

panels.description: Connections waiting for a lock another transaction holds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, service, max(v) AS value FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, max(Value) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_backends_max_tx_duration_seconds' AND service IN (${service:singlequote})
  GROUP BY time, service, series
) GROUP BY time, service ORDER BY time

SELECT time, service, sum(greatest(v - prev, 0)) / $__interval_s AS value FROM (
  SELECT time, service, series, v, lagInFrame(v, 1, v) OVER (PARTITION BY service, series ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prev
  FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, max(Value) AS v
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_stat_database_xact_commit' AND service IN (${service:singlequote})
    GROUP BY time, service, series
  )
) GROUP BY time, service ORDER BY time

SELECT time, service, sum(greatest(v - prev, 0)) / $__interval_s AS value FROM (
  SELECT time, service, series, v, lagInFrame(v, 1, v) OVER (PARTITION BY service, series ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prev
  FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, max(Value) AS v
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_stat_database_xact_rollback' AND service IN (${service:singlequote})
    GROUP BY time, service, series
  )
) GROUP BY time, service ORDER BY time

SELECT time, service, sum(greatest(v - prev, 0)) / $__interval_s AS value FROM (
  SELECT time, service, series, v, lagInFrame(v, 1, v) OVER (PARTITION BY service, series ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prev
  FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, max(Value) AS v
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_stat_database_deadlocks' AND service IN (${service:singlequote})
    GROUP BY time, service, series
  )
) GROUP BY time, service ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cache hit ratio

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, service, sumIf(d, kind = 'hit') / sum(d) AS value FROM (
  SELECT time, service, kind, greatest(v - lagInFrame(v, 1, v) OVER (PARTITION BY service, series, kind ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) AS d
  FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series,
      if(MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit', 'hit', 'read') AS kind, max(Value) AS v
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName IN ('cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_hit', 'cnpg_pg_stat_database_blks_read')
      AND service IN (${service:singlequote})
    GROUP BY time, service, series, kind
  )
) GROUP BY time, service HAVING sum(d) > 0 ORDER BY time

panels.description: Share of block reads served from shared buffers. Low values mean the working set doesn't fit in memory.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, service, sum(v) AS value FROM (

  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_database_size_bytes' AND service IN (${service:singlequote}) AND Attributes['datname'] NOT IN ('template0', 'template1')
  GROUP BY time, service, series

panels.description: Postgres stops accepting writes near 2 billion; autovacuum keeps it low.

panels.title: Since last WAL archive

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, service, min(v) AS value FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, toString(Attributes) AS series, min(Value) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_pg_stat_archiver_seconds_since_last_archival' AND service IN (${service:singlequote})
  GROUP BY time, service, series
) GROUP BY time, service ORDER BY time

panels.description: Grows on an idle database too; only a concern together with failing archiving.
